svg.text: Scheme D: solid tracks, colour = vehicle needed (white, brown, dark brown, near black), dashes = single track, pale red = closed

Tracks are the main network for an off-road audience, so they get the continuous line. Access: red = someone said no, dots = nobody said yes. Survey mode fades what has no answer: condition on tracks and rideable paths, access on paths. TH / CH: share of km.
paved surface, or grade1 without surface: a narrow white road · TH 0.7%, CH 14.8%
gravel, compacted, dirt..., grade2, grade3, smoothness bad or better · TH 3.7%, CH 55.7%
no tag, or only surface=unpaved: same look; faded in survey mode · TH 94.3%, CH 15.3%
smoothness=very_bad, grade4, rock, 4wd_only=recommended: a pickup passes · TH 0.7%, CH 8.6%
smoothness horrible or very_horrible, grade5 to 8, mud, 4wd_only yes or extreme · TH 0.6%, CH 5.6%
motorcycle yes, designated or permissive: a dashed single track, too narrow for four wheels
motorcycle=yes but no tag or only surface=unpaved: same look; faded in survey mode · TH 79.0%, CH 9.5%
motorcycle=yes with horrible or worse, grade5, mud
no motorcycle, motor_vehicle, vehicle or access tag, or unknown (85% of Thai path km): dots; faded in survey mode
smoothness=impassable: no wheeled vehicle, the same dots, not faded (an answer)
motorcycle, motor_vehicle, vehicle or access no, private, agricultural, forestry: thin pale red · CH 13.3%, TH 0.2% of track km
same on a path, keeps the single-track dashes · CH 3.6%, TH 1.8% of path km
